messages.subject: Passing reactive objects to plots
parts:
Hello

I have for() loop in a reactive expression that generates two vectors, "sampleRun" and "allRuns".  My intention is to plot these two vectors but I get the error that the objects cannot be found.  The inputs for the loop are controlled via several input boxes in the side panel.

server <- function(input, output) {
 
  reactive({
    random <- sample(1:1000, 1)
    allRuns <- c()

    for(i in 1:1000){
      dframe <- data.frame(as.numeric(), as.numeric())
      bin <- c()
      for(j in 1:input$opWeeks){
        refs <- input$slots-rpois(1, input$slots*input$refuse)
        if(refs<=0) refs=1
        activ <- data.frame(iteration=j, length=rpois(1:refs, lambda = input$los))
        dframe <- rbind(dframe, activ)
        bin <- c(bin, as.numeric(length(dframe$length)-
                                   length(dframe[round(dframe$length, 0) < dframe$iteration, 2])+1))
      }

      if(i == random) sampleRun <- bin
      allRuns <- c(allRuns, max(bin))
    }
  })
 
 
  output$runPlot <- renderPlot({
    qplot(seq_along(allRuns), allRuns) + geom_line()
  })
 
  output$samplePlot <- renderPlot({
    qplot(seq_along(sampleRun), sampleRun) + geom_line()
  })
}

How do I pass sampleRun and allRuns to the plots?

Cheers
Andrew

messages.subject: Re: Passing reactive objects to plots
parts:
I figured it out!

I forgot that reactive elements can be treated as functions, so I just added a variable name to reactive and then return(list(sampleRun, allRuns)) before closing.

server <- function(input, output) {
  n <- 100
  random <- sample(1:n, 1)
  allRuns <- c()
 
  x <- reactive({
   
    sl <- as.numeric(input$slots)
    rf <- as.numeric(input$refuse)
    ls <- as.numeric(input$los)
    wk <- as.numeric(input$opWeeks)
   
   
    set.seed(123)
    for(i in 1:n){

dframe <- data.frame(as.numeric(), as.numeric())
      bin <- c()

for(j in 1:wk){
        refs <- sl-rpois(1, sl*rf)
        #if(refs<=0) refs=1
        activ <- data.frame(iteration=j, length=rpois(1:refs, lambda = ls))

dframe <- rbind(dframe, activ)
        bin <- c(bin, as.numeric(length(dframe$length)-
                                   length(dframe[round(dframe$length, 0) < dframe$iteration, 2])+1))
      }
      if(i == random) sampleRun <- bin
      allRuns <- c(allRuns, max(bin))
    }

return(list(allRuns, sampleRun))
  })


I can then choose either allRuns or sampleRuns with x()[1] or x()[2] respectively.  For ggplot I needed to unlist. 

output$runPlot <- renderPlot({
   
    qplot(x = seq_along(unlist(x()[1])),  y= unlist(x()[1])) + geom_line()

})
